confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'The issue is likely mechanical or electrical rather than related to load balance.' and 'adding more laundry will not fix a spin failure'

blockingLoop.evidence: Customer asked three times 'just add towels and rerun?' and never got a consistent answer; it re-asked whether the drum goes back and forth and whether full loads spin fine, both already answered

rationale: The assistant correctly identified an unbalanced single heavy item early, then reversed itself, telling the customer not to add towels and that the machine has a mechanical or electrical fault needing an engineer. This contradicts the evidence (a full load spun fine yesterday, no code, drained fine) and the correct fix of adding towels. It also repeated already-answered questions and gave inconsistent advice, so the customer was sent toward an unnecessary engineer call-out.
